author: paper-design
name: simplex-noise
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Simplex Noise style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 5-color palette (#4449CF, #FFD1E0, #F94446, #FFD36B, #FFFFFF). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
